description: Imports registrants into a webinar from a CSV text, one row per person. Side effect: every imported person is added to the site, and each import can send a sign-up email to the imported addresses, so the people may receive mail from the host; nothing else on the campaign changes. Needs `session_id`, `webinar_id`, the `csv` text and a clear yes (`confirm` true). The text is capped at 20000 characters per call, so a long list is imported in parts. Use it when the host pasted a list or moved from another tool. For reading the current registrants use wi_list_webinar_leads_registrants.

confirm.description: Must be true, set only after the host said that these people may be imported and may receive a sign-up email.

csv.description: The CSV text, one row per person, with a header row the site can read. At most 20000 characters per call.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_import_registrants_csv
title: Import registrants from a CSV
